title: Daeun's Last Message
description:
You once said 'I'll treat you better once I'm in Gangnam.' When was that, exactly?
Today a text arrived from Daeun.
'I'm moving back to Busan next month. Met someone good. Take care of yourself.'

choices.result_text:
'Good for you. Be happy.'
After sending it, you stared at the screen for a long time.
Gangnam is still far. And Daeun is in Busan.

It rang three times.
No answer.
A text came. 'Take care :)'
That little emoji stayed in your eyes longer than it should have.

title: The Night Before
description:
Tomorrow is the contract. 3 billion. A Gangnam apartment.
Daeun texted. 'Free this evening?
Let's grab something simple to eat.'

choices.result_text:
It was a gukbap place.
Daeun pushed her bowl aside and said. 'Tomorrow?'
'Yeah.'
'I knew it from the beginning. You'll be fine.'
You slept well that night.

choices.text: Focus on tomorrow. Today is better alone
choices.result_text:
'I have some things to sort out today.'
Daeun replied 'Okay.'
You spent the night rereading the contract alone.
Whether it was the right call — who knows.

title: 2 AM
description:
A KakaoTalk notification from Daeun. 2 AM.
'Today was really rough. You awake?'
Looks like she just finished her night shift at the convenience store.

choices.result_text:
You talked for an hour.
Just hearing her voice settled something.
Fell asleep at 3 AM. Tomorrow will be a little rough — but that's okay.

choices.text: You were asleep. Text her tomorrow
choices.result_text:
In the morning her message said 'Oh, you were asleep. haha. It's nothing.'
At least you didn't leave her on read. That felt like enough.

title: At the Convenience Store in Gangnam
description:
You stopped by a convenience store in Gangnam for something.
No familiar face at the register. Of course.
But someone's near the exit. It's Daeun.
She's smiling. There's a man with her.

choices.result_text:
Daeun's eyes met yours. She paused for a moment, then smiled.
'Oh, hey.'
It was natural. The man didn't know anything.
You walked out. The night wind in Gangnam was cold.

You walked past.
She probably didn't see you.
You only slowed down after turning a full block.
You didn't know why.

title: Han Jiyeon's Introduction
description:
A message from Han Jiyeon.
'I know a tax accountant who manages personal portfolios.
Want to meet them? I thought you'd click.'

choices.result_text:
A tax accountant's office. We restructured the portfolio.
Later I calculated it — saved 12 million in taxes alone.
I texted Jiyeon to say thank you.
'Of course. I like honest people.' The reply came back.

choices.text: Pass — still want to do it solo
choices.result_text:
'I want to keep handling it on my own for now.'
Jiyeon said 'Okay.'
The offer came back to mind later while staring at a tax return.

title: A Call from Han Jiyeon's Mother
description:
An unknown number.
'I'm Jiyeon's mother. Do you have a moment to talk?'
It seems Jiyeon has been struggling. Her family is strongly opposed.

choices.result_text:
A café for one hour.
Her mother's expression never changed.
Coming out, you called Jiyeon. 'I talked to your mom.'
A brief silence. '...I know. Thank you.'

choices.text: This is Jiyeon's choice to make
choices.result_text:
'Jiyeon should decide that. I'm not going to interfere.'
Her mother paused, then hung up.
You didn't tell Jiyeon.

title: A Name in the News
description:
You stopped scrolling.
[Startup CEO arrested on investment fraud charges]
A name is in the article. Park Jaehyuk.
There's a photo. That face.

choices.result_text:
You posted. Comments came in. 'Me too. It happened to me too.'
Your ₩1M loss was ₩50M for someone else.
The money didn't come back — but something settled.

You closed it.
No anger. Just a hollow feeling.
You opened an old chat log — and closed it right away.

title: Jaehyuk's Counteroffer
description:
A call from Jaehyuk.
'Hey. I thought about it. This isn't fair.
I don't have money to give you three times. But you've got leverage on me too, haven't you.'
Can't tell if he's bluffing.

choices.result_text:
'I have everything recorded. I can file first.'
Jaehyuk went silent, then hung up.
A week later money arrived. Not triple — but the principal.

'Just give me the principal. Let's end this.'
Jaehyuk said 'Yeah, better that way.'
The money arrived. You never wanted to hear his voice again.

title: End of the Partnership
description:
The scheme you ran with Jaehyuk wrapped up.
You made more than expected. But at the final settlement, Jaehyuk quoted a different number.
'We agreed to split it this way.' Jaehyuk smiles. 'Hey, that's just how these things go.'

choices.text: Show the evidence — take the agreed split
choices.result_text:
You had a recording. Jaehyuk went cold.
You got the agreed cut. ₩58 million.
That's the end with Jaehyuk. It was always going to end this way.

choices.text: Take what he offers — don't want more entanglement
choices.result_text:
You took ₩32 million. ₩26 million less than agreed.
'Fine.' Jaehyuk patted your shoulder.
On the way out you washed your hands. Twice.

title: The Detective's Call
description:
An unknown number.
'I'm calling about the Park Jaehyuk case. Your name is on the victim list.
A trial has been scheduled. Are you available to testify as a witness?'

choices.result_text:
A courtroom.
Your eyes met Jaehyuk's. He looked away.
You gave your testimony and walked out.
The sky was clear.

choices.text: Decline — you already filed the report
choices.result_text:
'I have personal circumstances. I'll submit a written statement.'
The detective said that was fine.
That night you searched Jaehyuk's name in the news — then stopped.

title: Hyeonsu's Silence
description:
It's been four weeks since you handed money to Hyeonsu.
No word from him.
Calls go unanswered. The '1' on KakaoTalk never disappears.
You try one more time.

choices.result_text:
You went to his goshiwon.
He'd already checked out.
You walked for a while without knowing how far.
Back home you ran the numbers. ₩4 million gone.
₩4 million. Two months of living expenses.

choices.text: Let it go — it's not coming back
choices.result_text:
You hung up.
After a moment you blocked Hyeonsu.
This money is tuition. A lesson: never trust 'guaranteed info' again.

title: Hyeonsu's Call
description:
A call from Hyeonsu.
'Hey... I lost everything.'
His voice was different. Flat.
'Thirty million won. All gone.'

choices.result_text:
It slipped out.
Hyeonsu said '...You were right.'
After hanging up, you regretted saying it.
That's not what you say to someone who just lost ₩30 million.

You met up.
Hyeonsu barely spoke through the whole meal.
Walking out he said. 'Hey, thanks.'
You hadn't done anything. But he meant it.

title: Hyeonsu's Result
description:
A KakaoTalk from Hyeonsu.
'Hey Minjun. Remember when you talked me out of it?
I cut the amount down.
Results came out — half of it's still there. Because of you.'

choices.result_text:
Hyeonsu sent a thumbs-up emoji.
Out of nowhere, in the middle of the night, the mood lifted.
One fewer person got hurt. That's enough.

Hyeonsu said 'Yeah, I'm done with crypto for real.'
Not sure whether to believe him — but today, I chose to.

title: Father's Holiday Call
description:
Lunar New Year evening.
A call. It's Dad.
'You eat?'
That was it. Nothing else.

choices.text: "Yeah, I did. What about you, Dad?"
choices.result_text:
'I ate too.'
That was the end.
Not even five minutes.
You held the phone for a long time after hanging up.

choices.text: "I'm sorry, Dad. I'll definitely come next time"
choices.result_text:
'...I know you're busy.'
Dad hung up first.
You were about to say more — but didn't get the chance.
Next time, you really have to go.

title: Mom's Call
description:
It's been three weeks since you shot back 'My life is mine to live' at the holiday table.
Today Mom called.
'What you said that day... I still think about it.'

choices.result_text:
'I was out of line that day. I'm sorry, Mom.'
She said 'It's fine. You eating well?'
That 'it's fine' sounded like forgiveness.

Silence.
'...Alright. I understand.' She hung up.
You were right. But somehow it still felt uncomfortable.

title: Dad's Text
description:
Out of nowhere, a KakaoTalk from Dad.
'That gukbap was good. Come again sometime and we'll have it together.'
You couldn't remember the last time Dad sent you a message.

choices.result_text:
Dad replied 'No, that's my job.'
That reply lingered in your eyes for a long time.
Something felt like it was going right.

An emoji went through.
Dad sent one back.
A thumbs up.
It was the first time you'd ever seen him use an emoji.

title: In the Hallway
description:
A junior colleague whispered in the hallway today.
'Hey, the department head... he's still talking about you leaving early at the last work dinner.
Something like 'Where do they learn these manners these days.''

choices.text: Address it directly — explain to the head
choices.result_text:
'I had a prior commitment that day. I apologize.'
The head said 'It's fine' and walked on.
Whether it's resolved isn't clear — but at least it was said.

You can't live dancing to the department head's tune.
But you also know reputation builds slowly, grain by grain.
You focused on work today.

title: The Next Work Dinner
description:
A work dinner notice went up in the team chat.
A junior colleague messaged you separately.
'Of course you're coming, right? You always roll with the vibe.'

choices.result_text:
'I have something on.'
The colleague said 'Oh, okay.'
The team was quieter the next day.
But your body was fine.

You went.
You stayed late again.
'I knew we could count on you' — those words from someone.
In the taxi home you thought about what that meant.

title: Startup, Year One
description:
A year since you joined.
Your body has paid for it. But the service has grown.
The co-founder called. 'Minjun, the Series A came through. Your equity is worth ₩120 million right now.'

choices.result_text:
'Let's grow it more. The exit is too early.'
Salary went up. Equity held.
₩120 million is just the beginning.

choices.text: Sell some equity in a secondary
choices.result_text:
You sold 30% in a secondary for ₩40 million.
Reduced the risk.
₩40 million hit the account. The first money you'd actually realized.

title: Startup Dividend
description:
A year at a sustainable pace.
The service turned profitable.
The co-founder said. 'Dividend this quarter ₩7 million. That's your share.'

choices.result_text:
'Put it back into the company.'
The co-founder smiled. 'That's why I trust you.'
No short-term gain — but it felt right.

₩7 million arrived.
Steady income isn't bad at all.
No burnout to get here — that felt like the real win.

title: Six Months Going It Alone
description:
Six months since you split from the co-founder.
The direction you chose alone might be right — or wrong.
Today you got the first 10 paying customers.

choices.result_text:
It took three months to go from 10 to 100.
Alone — but alone meant fast.
Every decision had a reason. And that reason was yours.

You held at 10 customers for a month.
Revenue was small but there were no losses.
Going it alone was slow — but it was yours.
